xmldoc.short_description: Check a WFDB record for the faults a reader cannot otherwise see.

param_input_item.param_description: the record, with or without its .hea extension.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with ok (true when nothing is wrong) and issues (a cellstr of what is).

description.p: Checks a record for the faults a reader cannot otherwise see: a header that does not parse, a signal file that is missing or too short for the samples it promises, and a signal whose samples do not sum to the checksum the header stores.

The checksum is the format's own guard against a file truncated on disk, the modulo-65536 sum of a signal's samples, and this is the one place it is verified; a stored checksum of zero is the writer saying it computed none and is not held against the signal. A single-segment record is checked in full; a multi-segment record is reported as not checked here, because each segment is its own record to validate.
